ToggleGroup.description: Provides a shared state to a series of toggle buttons.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The pressed state of the toggle group represented by an array of
the values of all pressed toggle buttons.
This is the uncontrolled counterpart of `value`.

props.name: value
props.description:
The pressed state of the toggle group represented by an array of
the values of all pressed toggle buttons.
This is the controlled counterpart of `defaultValue`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback fired when the pressed states of the toggle group changes.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description:
Whether to loop keyboard focus back to the first item
when the end of the list is reached while using the arrow keys.

props.name: multiple
props.description:
When `false` only one item in the group can be pressed. If any item in
the group becomes pressed, the others will become unpressed.
When `true` multiple items can be pressed.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the toggle group should ignore user interaction.

props.name: class
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.description: Replace the default element with a tag name, component, or render function.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: Indicates the orientation of the toggle group.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the toggle group is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-multiple
dataAttributes.description: Present when the toggle group allows multiple buttons to be in the pressed state at the same time.
